name: BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG)
summary: Early-stage grant for biotechnology and life sciences ideas that need to establish proof of concept. One of the few genuinely pre-revenue grants available in India, and correspondingly competitive.
administering_ministry: Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science and Technology
benefit_description: Grant of up to Rs 50 lakh over roughly 18 months to establish proof of concept, available to a startup or to an individual entrepreneur through a host institution.

criteria.description: The applicant entity must be early stage. BIG funds ideas at the proof-of-concept stage, not established revenue businesses.
The company, where the applicant is a company, must be incorporated in India with majority Indian shareholding.
The proposal must be in biotechnology or an allied life sciences area, and must be technically novel rather than an incremental variation on an existing product.
The proposal must define a clear, measurable proof-of-concept milestone achievable within the grant period. Vague research directions do not survive review.

document_requirements.document_name: Detailed technical proposal with milestones and budget
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepared in-house. This is the application: reviewers are domain scientists, and a weak experimental plan is the usual reason for rejection.
Already issued at incorporation. Individual applicants apply through a host institution instead.

document_requirements.document_name: CVs of the principal investigator and key team members
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepared in-house. Reviewers weigh whether the team can actually execute the science proposed.

windows.notes: BIG runs in discrete calls announced on the BIRAC portal, typically once or twice a year. Missing a call means waiting for the next, so the call announcement is the date that matters.

benefits.description: Grant of up to Rs 50 lakh to establish proof of concept.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Released against agreed technical milestones and periodic review, not as a lump sum.
